title: Parking
description:
I played the role of an Income Tax Officer in a brief 5-minute scene. Although it was my debut appearance, I delivered a strong and confident performance that was well appreciated.
Parking - I made my acting debut in the Tamil film Parking, where I portrayed the role of an Income Tax Officer in a short yet impactful 5-minute scene. Despite the limited screen time, I focused on delivering a natural and convincing performance that added value to the storyline. This opportunity marked the beginning of my journey in the film industry, allowing me to gain on-set experience and understand the nuances of acting in a professional environment. My role required a confident screen presence and precise dialogue delivery, which I executed effectively. Even though it was a small role, it helped me showcase my potential and passion for acting. I am eager to take on more challenging roles and continue growing as a versatile actor.
